description: Source code defining user-defined Python functions and table functions for Spark SQL, including classes for UDFs, UDTFs, and analysis runners, with methods for building, applying, and analyzing Python-based functions within Spark.

classes.name: UserDefinedPythonFunction
classes.description: Represents a user-defined Python function with methods to build expressions and columns for Spark SQL.

classes.name: UserDefinedPythonTableFunction
classes.description: Represents a user-defined Python table function with methods to build logical plans and DataFrames.

classes.name: UserDefinedPythonTableFunctionAnalyzeRunner
classes.description: Runs the analyze static method of a Python UDTF, handling serialization/deserialization and communication with Python worker.

methods.name: builder
methods.description: Constructs an expression for the UDF based on input expressions or columns.

methods.name: builderWithColumns
methods.description: Builds an expression from a sequence of columns.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates a Column that evaluates the UDF with given expressions.

methods.name: fromUDFExpr
methods.description: Converts an expression into a Column, handling aggregate expressions.

methods.name: builder
methods.description: Constructs a logical plan for the Python table function based on expressions and parser.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates a DataFrame by applying the UDTF with specified arguments.

methods.name: writeToPython
methods.description: Serializes and sends the UDTF and its arguments to the Python worker.

methods.name: receiveFromPython
methods.description: Receives and deserializes the analysis result or exception from the Python worker.
